visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person's hands hold a large black bowl of ramen with a thick yellow broth, topped with sliced meat, a soft-boiled egg, and seaweed, against a dark restaurant background. (2) Inside a professional kitchen, two stainless steel pots boil on gas burners, with steam rising; kitchen staff in dark uniforms and blue gloves use a mesh strainer to drain noodles. (3) The chef carefully plates the ramen, adding slices of char siu pork and a garnish of greens to the bowl. (4) Close-up shots feature two distinct ramen types: one with a creamy 'white' broth and another with a clear broth, both meticulously garnished with eggs and lime. (5) A side dish of long, thin beef sushi topped with green onions is presented on a rectangular blue plate. (6) A hand opens a wooden drawer integrated into the table, revealing neatly arranged compartments for toothpicks and spices like Japanese pepper. (7) The scene shifts to the restaurant exterior during the day, showing a stone-textured wall, a large white lantern with Japanese text, and a digital menu board.
